HT-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.name: Display a specified referent-group behavior prevalence statement
HT-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.definition: Present to a recipient a declared numerical prevalence or frequency estimate for one specified behavior, referent group and observation window, without necessarily comparing it to the recipient's own behavior or prior estimate.
HT-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.identityBoundary: The statement's behavior, referent group, period and claimed statistic define the occurrence parameters; efficacy, recipient belief, behavioral response and source truthfulness are not identity attributes.
HT-CAND-INF-LAYER-0001.deduplicationFinding: The existing comparative feedback panel includes own behavior, perceived-peer and measured-peer comparison. A single prevalence statement lacks those identity-defining components, so it is not an exact duplicate.

REUSED-HT-V1-PSY-LAYER-005.usedFor: Personalized comparative own/perceived-peer/measured-peer normative feedback route
REUSED-HT-V1-PSY-LAYER-005.reason: The college feedback package is not an isolated single prevalence-statement intervention.
